The Experience

Breathe to the Beat Live

A transformational breath workout powered by music.

Familiar music meets intentional breathing. You build a more resilient nervous system, grow your capacity to navigate stress, and reconnect with yourself.

No movement required. You lie down for the whole experience while your breath does the work. We close with a restorative sound bath.

The Energy

The music is the medicine.

This is not breathing to a quiet track. It is a production. The beat sets the pace. The sound carries the room. Every breath rides the rhythm you already know in your body.

That is what makes people stay. And come back.

The Practice

Three techniques. One journey back to yourself.

01

Box Breathing

Equal counts in, hold, out, hold. It slows the heart rate and steadies the mind. This is the reset. It brings you fully into the present moment and creates a felt sense of calm before we go deeper.

02

Breath of Power

Rapid, active breathing through the mouth. It floods the body with energy and heat. Focus sharpens. Stuck emotion starts to move. This is where you meet your own aliveness again.

03

Circular Breath

Continuous, connected breathing with no pause between inhale and exhale. Trained in the David Elliott lineage. It opens space for clarity, deep emotional release, and reconnection with yourself.
